about: GTA 6 detail (Delta, slug gta-calmchaos): in Rockstar's 'An Extended Look' (Aug 27 2026, 'captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5'), one continuous stretch runs from a calm car conversation (13:10, 790 s; they argue whether the guy they're texting is a cop: 'A dude could be a cop for all we know' / 'He's not a cop... he's just cautious') to a man yelling in the back seat (13:41), bandana masks (13:48), a rifle out the window (13:58) and a police truck flipping in a street shootout (14:09, 849.5 s): about 59 seconds. Sources in BRIEF.md.
